current_activity: The 344th Infantry Division moves in behind the 275th Division in the Hürtgen Forest
notes: Event date: CMH Siegfried Line Campaign ch. 18 p. 437: "During the night of 19 November and the next day, the 344th moved in behind the 275th Division"; ch. 20 p. 465: "the last contingents of the 344th Infantry Division which the Seventh Army had summoned up from the south were arriving" by 21 November. Event definition: the move of the night of 19 November and the next day; the last contingents were still arriving on 21 November. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Hürtgen with a precision of 10 km, the forest sector behind the 275th Division. Location approximate: a town point for the forest sector. Location support: CMH names the 275th Division sector. Commander: unknown. Opponents: US VII Corps (8th and 22nd Infantry Regiments).
